act.name: Passports Act, 1967
act.source_authority: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing passports and travel documents, refusal, impounding, revocation, appeals and offences.

sections.title: Refusal of passports, travel documents, etc.
sections.text: Section 6 specifies grounds on which a passport authority may refuse a passport or travel document; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: A passport may be refused only on statutory grounds, subject to the Act's process and remedies.
